messages:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: route=continuous-batching path p99 latency crossed 2.5s for last 5m. impact: streaming stalls + increased 502s for long-seq workloads. stats: p95=220ms -> 780ms, p99=1.1s -> 3.2s. stack: infer-prod-eu1

Alex K: saw the bot, digging in. which model and routing?

Maria P: looks correlated with mixed sequence length traffic from customer acme-payments and a few internal canaries. continuous-batching queue depth spiked.

Jordan L: I'm on logs. I see a lot of `kv-cache` pressure in the runtime and scheduler is coalescing small+large seq into same batch -> big tails.

Samira R: confirm p99 spikes align with 10:02–10:12 window. heatmap: long tail on worker-gpu-03.

Alex K: can we throttle long-seq routing to a cold-path? maybe force small-quantized variant for that customer temporarily.

Maria P: we have a compatible low-latency variant (gptx-small-q2). Canary showed ~60% lower tail. risk: slight quality delta.

Jordan L: quick mitigation options: 
- reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 24 on cont-batch scheduler
- enable sequence-length-aware batching (fair-share) flag `sched.fair_seq=true`
- route long sequences to `gptx-small-q2` via policy rule for tenant acme-payments

Samira R: prefer staged: 1) reduce max_batch_size on hotspot workers, 2) enable fair_seq, 3) route customer if still bad.

Alex K: agreed. I'll patch config on worker-gpu-03 and gpu-04 now. doing `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/cont-batch --env="MAX_BATCH=24"` and rolling restart limited to those nodes.

SRE-Bot: Deploy job started by Alex K (rollout id r-4583). watch logs: /deploys/r-4583

Maria P: applying `sched.fair_seq=true` on scheduler config now (hot reload).

Jordan L: logs show immediate drop in batching mix variance after fair_seq toggled: `batch_size_mean` down 38% for mixed clients. Observed p99 drop to ~1.2s within 90s.

Alex K: rolling restart finished on targets. verifying metrics.

Samira R: customer-facing error rate (5xx) down from 0.9% -> 0.12% for acme. overall p99 trending to 850ms.

Maria P: still seeing some streaming stalls (a few lingering sessions). suspect prefix caching thrash for long-seq sessions. Jordan, can you check KV cache evictions?

Jordan L: yes - high eviction spikes at same time window, due to mixed KV footprints. temp mitigation: bump per-worker cache size by 20% and mark acme requests as `cache-exempt` if routed to small-q2.

Samira R: doing cost/impact check: bumping cache is fine short term, will increase mem pressure but safer than tail at scale.

Alex K: I'm going to create routing rule for acme-payments: `if tenant==acme && seq_len>1024 -> model=gptx-small-q2 priority=high`. Applying now.

SRE-Bot: Route rule updated (rule id rr-973).

Maria P: after all steps, p95=180ms, p99=620ms, 5xx back to baseline. Good for now.

Alex K: handoff: I have to drop off in 12m. Samira, can you take over post-mitigation oncall until 13:00 UTC?

Samira R: taking it. will run 30m watch and open postmortem draft.

oncall-next: @Samira R noted. next oncall will join at 13:00 UTC.

Jordan L: action items: 
- short-term: keep fair_seq enabled for 24h and monitor `batch_tail` metric.
- med-term: implement sequence-length bucketing in scheduler (ticket INF-6221).
- follow-up: run load tests with mixed seq lengths to validate batching heuristics (owner: Maria).

Maria P: I'll create INF-6221 and schedule a perf run. also will reach out to acme-contacts to explain temporary model route + invite them to do evals.

Alex K: adding temporary dashboard panel for `per-tenant batch mix` + p99 overlay.

SRE-Bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev3, start=1802001234, mitigated=1802001684, owner=Samira R.

Samira R: drafting postmortem now, will include timeline, mitigations, and recommended config defaults. If anyone observed additional client impacts drop a note here. :memo:

Alex K: none from me. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Maria P: noted one internal canary fail around 10:05 but it auto-recovered after routing change. I'll add to notes.

Jordan L: saving logs and flamegraphs to /artifacts/infra/1802001234/mix-batch.

Samira R: leaving shift in 10m, handing to oncall-next. watch and escalate if p99 > 1s for more than 5m.

oncall-next: taking over at 13:00 UTC. will review playbook and monitor.

SRE-Bot: Incident closed for oncall rotation.
